strategies.strategy_name_en: Identity theorem reduction from a subset
strategies.summary_en: To prove that two sufficiently regular functions on a domain are identical, it can be enough to verify equality on a smaller subset. Strong regularity lets local or partial information determine the global function.
strategies.applicability: Applies when working with classes of functions whose values on a dense set, accumulation set, or other determining subset uniquely determine the whole function.
strategies.callout_body: 为了验证，在$U$上拥有某种好的正则性$P$的两个函数$f,g$恒等，我们只需要验证在子集$S\subset U$上恒等。即正则性强的对象，局部信息包含了全局信息。
